titleText: JTF News: World Health Organization, ABC News Australia
mainText: The World Health Organization stated that an Ebola outbreak may have started as early as January.
SpaceX aims to raise $75 billion through an initial public offering.
Israel and Lebanon renew ceasefire following US-brokered talks.
U.S. authorities discovered a tunnel at the U.S.-Mexico border used for drug smuggling.
The House of Representatives approved a war powers resolution regarding military action against Iran.
